title: Field Notes 05: the 2×2 that ran the world for 2,000 years
caption:
Before 16 types, there was a 2×2.

Warm or cool, moist or dry: four boxes, four temperaments. Air (sanguine), Fire (choleric), Water (phlegmatic) and Earth (melancholic), each linked to a season in the classical texts. Hippocrates, Galen and Ibn Sina all worked with versions of it.

History and traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

Save this, comment the box you'd put yourself in, and tag the friend who is obviously box 2.
